Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to actually watch the video or access the video content to observe the bird's characteristics. Instead, it relied on a web search that returned a Facebook post (Search Result 5) containing a transcript snippet mentioning "rock hoppers" and a bird that "can't fly." The agent incorrectly assumed this text snippet was sufficient evidence to identify the species without verifying the visual content of the actual YouTube video. This led to a premature and unverified conclusion based on a search result snippet rather than direct observation of the video evidence required by the task plan.
